_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/accounting-extra.jsx GLChartOfAccounts (L40-121) + COA_CLASSES (L7-13). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx source — same pattern as cc-strings.json / gr-strings.json. crumbSection/crumbScreen render the breadcrumb; class names (cls1..cls5) render the class-group headers. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, em-dash U+2014, baht U+0E3F). Values present in i18n-full.json.phrases resolve via tp(); values in _missing are NOT yet in i18n-full.json — they render honest Thai (th) / key-fallback (en/zh/ar) and are flagged for the Wave-2 i18n round (P2-WEB-13). Export/status/edit/cancel/all reuse existing DICT keys (vendor.btnExport / common.status / common.edit / common.cancel / common.all) via t(), not this file.
